A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same COMPRESSM research work and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–F. Text comparison and visual inspection support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original LRU benchmark experiments, compression comparisons, ablations, timing measurements, and Mamba evaluations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains original LRU and Mamba results, including benchmark accuracies, compression outcomes, ablations, and timing measurements.

M1.justification: Section 3.1, Equation 8 corrects the stated rank-selection rule from retaining τ to retaining 1−τ of HSV energy, also corrected in Appendix D.2. This changes the written criterion for a given τ; the remaining algorithm, pragmatic variant, and Mamba adaptation are unchanged. The PDFs do not establish changed implementation or rerun experiments.

E1.justification: The LRU evaluations retain sMNIST, CIFAR10, ListOps, AAN, IMDB, and Pathfinder. Appendix E retains the same Mamba CIFAR/IMDB evaluations. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same unreduced baselines, HNN regularization on sMNIST, knowledge distillation on CIFAR10, and random/top-HSV truncation comparators in the relevant analyses.

E3.justification: Section 4.1, Table 3, and the appendices retain the same training budgets, model configurations, reduction schedules, numerical tolerance grids, and evaluation metrics. The algorithmic threshold correction is not accompanied by a reported revision of experimental settings.

E4.justification: Appendix C retains the selection-strategy, reduction-count, and reduction-window ablations. The HSV trajectory analyses, pragmatic-variant evaluation, timing/scalability studies, and Mamba case study also retain the same evidence.

E5.justification: The stated five-seed main/Mamba evaluations and ten-seed appendix ablations/comparisons are unchanged, as are the top-3/top-1 summaries and standard-deviation/error-band reporting practices.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2 and 4–7 and the empirical figures retain the same numerical results and observed trends. For example, Table 1's CIFAR10 comparison at τ=0.1 remains 85.7% accuracy for COMPRESSM versus 81.8% for the baseline.

T1.justification: Equation 8's mathematical definition of retained rank is corrected to use the complementary threshold 1−τ, consistent with the experimental tolerance convention. The assumptions, theorems, continuity lemma, and complexity derivations remain unchanged; transpose, norm, and matrix-square-root edits are equivalent notation.

C1.justification: The conclusion replaces categorical dominant-HSV rank-preservation wording with explicitly empirical stability and adds a broader claim of high-capacity performance at both small-model training and inference overheads. The abstract and main contribution list retain their claims.

C2.justification: The conclusion omits its previous requirement for sufficient training between reductions, although Section 4.2 retains that qualification. Appendix E.3.3 also corrects the heavy-tailed-HSV refinement caveat from LTI to LTV systems, matching the Mamba discussion.

D1.justification: The code-access statement and implementation disclosures remain unchanged, including Appendix A's hyperparameters, Appendix D's hardware and compilation details, Appendix E's Mamba implementation, and Appendix F's regularization/distillation settings.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Section 5 shortens the Yu et al. (2024) passage while retaining the same distinction between initialization and compression; no references are added or removed.

P1.justification: v4 makes distributed grammar and typo corrections, standardizes COMPRESSM styling, rewrites the conclusion, adds acknowledgments, and updates affiliations. The main section and appendix organization remains intact.

P2.justification: v4 adds an ICLR 2026 running header, adjusts the title block and conclusion/acknowledgment page flow, and makes small caption/table-label typography edits. All 24 figures and seven numbered tables retain their scientific content and overall designs.

improvement.justification: Correcting Equation 8 and Appendix D.2 resolves an operational inconsistency with the reported tolerance convention. The conclusion better distinguishes Weyl-based tracking from empirical stability, and copyediting improves clarity. These focused gains outweigh the limited weakening of qualifications caused by dropping the conclusion's reduction-spacing caveat and broadening its small-model cost wording.
